7. The Toggle System

7.1 What is the Toggle System?

The Toggle System is the central UI component of the ABpE Portal for collapsible/expandable sections. It is used by the Documentation Module, CV Editor, Admin Portal and all other modules. The logic is fully implemented in core-init.js and ui-components.css — no custom code needed.

7.2 HTML Structure

A toggle section consists of three elements:

<div class="toggle-section">

    <!-- Header: clickable, contains arrow icon -->
    <div class="section-header" onclick="toggleSection(this)">
        <i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i>       <!-- Icon left -->
        <span>Section Title</span>               <!-- Text -->
        <i class="bi bi-chevron-down"></i>       <!-- Arrow right -->
    </div>

    <!-- Content: expands/collapses -->
    <div class="section-content">
        <p>Section content...</p>
    </div>

</div>

7.3 The toggleSection() Function

The function is defined in core-init.js and globally available:

// In core-init.js — automatically available for all modules:
window.toggleSection = function(header) {
    if (!header) return;
    header.classList.toggle('open');              // Header gets .open
    const content = header.nextElementSibling;    // Next element = Content
    if (content) content.classList.toggle('open'); // Content gets .open
};

Important: header.nextElementSibling must be the .section-content element — directly after the header, no element in between.

7.4 CSS Classes in Detail

/* toggle-section — outer container */
.toggle-section {
    border:        1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--border-radius-card);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    overflow:      hidden;
}

/* section-header — clickable area */
.section-header {
    display:         flex;
    align-items:     center;
    gap:             10px;
    padding:         14px 18px;
    background:      var(--abcona-blue);
    color:           white;
    cursor:          pointer;
    user-select:     none;
    transition:      background 0.2s;
}

.section-header:hover {
    background: var(--abcona-blue-light);
}

/* Arrow icon rotates when open */
.section-header .bi-chevron-down {
    margin-left:      auto;            /* pushes arrow to the right */
    transition:       transform 0.25s ease;
}

.section-header.open .bi-chevron-down {
    transform: rotate(180deg);         /* rotates on .open */
}

/* section-content — collapsible/expandable content */
.section-content {
    max-height:  0;
    overflow:    hidden;
    padding:     0 18px;
    background:  var(--abcona-gray-card);
    transition:  max-height 0.3s ease, padding 0.3s ease;
}

.section-content.open {
    max-height:  2000px;    /* large enough for any content */
    padding:     18px;
}

7.5 Opening a Toggle via JavaScript

Sometimes a section needs to be opened programmatically (e.g., when clicking in the table of contents):

// Open section by ID
function openSection(sectionId) {
    const section = document.getElementById('section-' + sectionId);
    if (!section) return;
    const header  = section.querySelector('.section-header');
    const content = section.querySelector('.section-content');
    if (header && !header.classList.contains('open')) {
        header.classList.add('open');
        if (content) content.classList.add('open');
    }
}

// Scroll to section and open
function scrollToSection(sectionId) {
    const section = document.getElementById('section-' + sectionId);
    if (!section) return;
    openSection(sectionId);
    section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
}

7.6 Open / Close All Sections

// Open all
function openAllSections() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.section-header').forEach(h => {
        if (!h.classList.contains('open')) toggleSection(h);
    });
}

// Close all
function closeAllSections() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.section-header.open').forEach(h => {
        toggleSection(h);
    });
}

7.7 Creating a Toggle Section Dynamically

Create toggle sections dynamically in JavaScript (like in the Documentation Module):

function createToggleSection(id, title, contentHtml, iconClass = 'bi-info-circle') {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'toggle-section';
    div.id = 'section-' + id;
    div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="section-header" onclick="toggleSection(this)">
            <i class="bi ${iconClass}"></i>
            <span>${title}</span>
            <i class="bi bi-chevron-down"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="section-content">${contentHtml}</div>
    `;
    return div;
}

// Usage:
const container = document.getElementById('chapters-container');
container.appendChild(
    createToggleSection('grundlagen', '1. Basics', '<p>Content...</p>')
);
